title: A changed home and shifting feelings

captions.emotions: Responding to each turn of transition

meaning: Renewing home together offers more support when leaving the former way does not turn every new feeling into a final verdict on the decision.
text: In domestic arrangements, you can act through shared consent: hearing needs, choosing comfort together and participating in change. The Lovers in the physical position of Muladhara describe this togetherness through action. Death in energy tests your footing through abruptly ending former routines and leaving them no room. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions responds to turns in transition: spacious today, unfamiliar and inconvenient tomorrow. A good shared decision can therefore feel uneven when each response immediately requires the new life to be declared either successful or mistaken.

For example, you jointly clear surplus furniture from a room. It initially feels light, but that evening there is nowhere familiar for a book or cup. **Different feelings during transition do not cancel the meaning of a shared choice.** A small arrangement for tonight reveals a specific need without restoring everything old. Change has time to become lived in, and another turn of mood need not reopen whether altering your home was worthwhile at all.

The difficulty is answering each emotional wave with another abrupt decision. You want the old restored immediately or still more removed. The routine stays unsettled longer than the change itself required. Stability grows through preserving your shared choice and refining it through small actions, without turning temporary inconvenience into a final verdict on your ability to live together.
